summary: Round-7 Super Admin dashboard end-to-end verification. Backend: 22/22 admin tests + 33/33 prior-regression tests pass against the live preview URL. Frontend: admin can sign in with admin@wehive.co.in (mock OTP 123456), /admin renders Overview with all four metric cards (users=36, applications=24, revenue=₹88,032, countries=250) and all seven sidebar tabs. Non-admin sees the admin-forbidden screen. UserMenu shows the 'Super admin' link with data-testid=usermenu-admin only for admins. /account profile edit regression passes (name persists across reload). Country filter regression on public /api/countries (delivery, documents, no_visa) holds.

minor.issue: When the supplied phone collides with an existing unique-indexed phone, the route returns a raw 500 (pymongo DuplicateKeyError) instead of a graceful 409/400. Reproducible: PUT body {phone: "<existing-phone>"}. Suggest catching DuplicateKeyError and returning HTTPException(409, 'Phone already in use').

issues: The user-menu trigger button (the Admin/avatar pill in the navbar) is missing a data-testid (e.g. data-testid=usermenu-trigger). Only the dropdown items are tagged. This makes Playwright tests rely on text/role selectors. Add it to the trigger button in /app/frontend/src/components/UserMenu.jsx.

action_items: [MINOR] Catch DuplicateKeyError in PUT /api/users/me and return 409 with a friendly message instead of bubbling a 500.
[NICE-TO-HAVE] Add data-testid=usermenu-trigger to the avatar/account button in UserMenu.jsx so automated tests can open the menu without relying on user-name text matching.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.py duplicates revenue calculation (constants & _revenue_for) that already lives in front-end fee logic — keep these in sync; consider moving to a shared backend module if the calculation grows.

DELETE /api/admin/users also deletes the user's applications and saved plans (correct cascading), but no soft-delete/audit log. For a real super-admin product this should be reversible or at least audit-logged.

PATCH /api/admin/integrations writes os.environ[k] in-process. If running behind multiple workers, only the worker that handled the PATCH will see the new OTP_CHANNEL until the settings_col is re-read. The current /send-otp does check settings_col via lookups in some places — confirm OTP route reads from settings_col first to keep behaviour consistent across workers.
Twilio creds in backend/.env are committed real-looking SID/Token values — confirm they are sandbox/dummy. If real, rotate.

PUT /api/users/me has a known 500 on duplicate phone (unique index) — avoid reusing the same phone across test users.
rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/users/me lacks try/except around users.update_one; pymongo's E11000 DuplicateKeyError on the phone_1 unique index escapes as a 500. Mitigation: wrap update_one with try/except DuplicateKeyError and translate to HTTPException(409). Reproduction: create user A with phone +919876543210, log in as user B, PUT /api/users/me {phone: '+919876543210'} → 500.
